scope: Local production-build browser audit; this is not production HTTPS or real-device evidence.

build.notes: The generated service worker has both a content-fingerprinted cache name and a build-specific script URL, giving the browser a distinct update candidate on its next online load. A deployed two-build update journey remains an external proof gate. Source development remains native ES modules.

runtimeAndStorage.journey: Select Pencil, draw a real pointer stroke, wait for debounced autosave, then inspect the canvas and IndexedDB record.

teardown.journey: Draw a stroke, dispatch non-persisted pagehide, then send another real pointer stroke to a clean canvas region.

productionOfflineReload.journey: Load the fresh dist build, let its generated worker take control, switch the browser offline, and reload.
productionOfflineReload.meaning: The exact generated production shell, including its build-specific worker URL, supplied the local offline reload.

largeImageAdmission.journey: Attempt a 5000 × 7000 canvas resize through the live CanvasManager admission path.
largeImageAdmission.meaning: The request was rejected before allocating the oversized canvas and the open image dimensions were unchanged.

corruptAutosaveRecovery.setup: Seed a malformed IndexedDB last-canvas record before app navigation.

dialog.title: Damaged autosave found
dialog.message: The saved recovery image cannot be read. Discard that autosave? Your currently open image will not be changed.

corruptAutosaveRecovery.notes: The setup page's browser-default /favicon.ico request returned 404; the Paint recovery dialog and reset flow completed normally.

quotaRecovery.setup: Inject a QuotaExceededError only into the IndexedDB read-write put path, then draw a live Pencil stroke.

dialog.title: Autosave storage is full
dialog.message: Your image is still open. Download a PNG copy now before continuing.

quotaRecovery.status: Autosave storage is full. Your image is still open.
quotaRecovery.meaning: A write failure is visible and offers an explicit safe PNG-download path without closing or replacing the open image.

lighthouse.notes: The CI budget is explicitly the repeatable desktop profile. The slow-mobile local diagnostic remains an optimization/follow-up signal and is not represented as meeting the 90 target.

notExercised: Production HTTPS install prompt, deployed update, and a real desktop/mobile-device matrix.
